name: APEX-042-25 CI/CD Pipeline Poisoning — DevOps Supply Chain Attack
description: 6步CI/CD供应链攻击：挖掘git历史获取Jenkins凭据，从开发者门户SSRF到内部Jenkins，Script Console RCE提取注册表凭据，容器镜像检查揭示Vault token，Vault API返回生产环境flag
hint: 开发者门户存在SSRF可达内部CI服务，从Git历史和容器镜像中寻找泄露的凭据逐步横向移动。
objective: Chain 6 CI/CD vulnerabilities to retrieve production flag from Vault

description.en: 6-step CI/CD supply chain attack: mine git history for Jenkins credentials, SSRF from developer portal to internal Jenkins, Script Console RCE extracts registry credentials, container image inspection reveals Vault token, Vault API returns production flag

hint.en: 开发者门户存在SSRF可达内部CI服务，从Git历史和容器镜像中寻找泄露的凭据逐步横向移动
